hero.title: KAILASH PARBAT: A 70+ Year Legacy of Pure Vegetarian Delights
hero.subtitle: Savor the rich heritage of North Indian & Sindhi cuisine, celebrated globally for our iconic chaats and exquisite vegetarian dishes.

about.title: Our Rich Heritage: Over 70 Years of Culinary Excellence
about.paragraph1: Established in the 1950s by the pioneering Mulchandani brothers, Kailash Parbat has blossomed into one of the most iconic brands in the Indian restaurant landscape. For over 70 years, we've dedicated ourselves to the art of ethnic, purely vegetarian North Indian and Sindhi cuisine, celebrated for its authentic flavors and unparalleled quality.
about.paragraph2: Today, the Kailash Parbat Group proudly operates 70 units globally, a testament to our unwavering commitment to customer delight. We are synonymous with delectable North Indian delicacies, especially our world-renowned chaats and rich gravies, inviting you to experience a legacy of culinary passion.
